name: Jira Cloud
description: Track Action1 security and operational findings in Jira automatically.

actions.label: Validate Configuration
actions.description: Validates Jira Cloud connectivity and required configuration.

actions.label: List Jira Org Project Mappings
actions.description: Loads Action1 organization to Jira project and issue type mappings from Jira-owned storage.

actions.label: Save Jira Org Project Mapping
actions.description: Creates or updates a Jira org-to-project-and-issue-type mapping row.

actions.label: Delete Jira Org Project Mapping
actions.description: Deletes a Jira org-to-project-and-issue-type mapping row.

actions.label: Discover Action1 Mapping Options
actions.description: Loads read-only Action1 organization options for the Mapping screen.

actions.label: Discover Jira Project Mapping Options
actions.description: Loads read-only Jira project options for the Mapping screen.

actions.label: Discover Jira Issue Type Mapping Options
actions.description: Loads read-only Jira issue type options for a selected Jira project.

actions.label: Sync
actions.description: Runs Jira candidate preparation plus Jira MVP create/get/update/no-op lifecycle orchestration.
